newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct department store sales up 1.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct department store sales up 1.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Sales at department stores in Japan in October rose 1.6 percent from a year earlier to 737.7 billion yen, the third consecutive month of year-on-year increases, the Japan Department Stores' Association said on Monday.
Sales were active in the second half of October due to favourable weather and renovations of stores, the association said in its monthly report.
However, the growth in sales was curbed by a decline in demand from corporate customers and fewer holidays in the month compared with last year, the report said.
Nevertheless, sales in men's and women's clothing were brisk, rising 3.1 percent and 4.8 percent respectively against October last year.

Sales of fresh food showed signs of recovery, the report said. Many Japanese consumers cut down on fresh food purchases this summer due to a food-poisoning epidemic which killed at least 10 people and made thousands ill.
